newsitem.title: GERMANY: German August industry output rises nearly one pct.
newsitem.headline: German August industry output rises nearly one pct.

text.p: Industrial production rose nearly one percent in Germany in August, the economics ministry said on Tuesday.
Pan-German industry output rose 0.8 percent in August from the previous month. July data were revised slightly higher to show a 1.1 percent rise in output from a month earlier.
Based on data provided by the Bundesbank, central bank, pan-German industry output rose 1.8 percent in August from the same month a year earlier after a year-on-year decline of 0.5 percent in July.
"The fundamental upwards trend observed since March is continuing without weakening," the economics ministry said.

In west Germany, industry output rose 0.3 percent in August from the previous month and was up 2.1 percent year-on-year. East German industry production 5.1 percent from July and was unchanged from a year earlier.

The largest increase was seen in the pan-German manufacturing sector, where production of intermediate goods rose 2.6 percent in August from the previous month and durable goods, which include the car and large appliance industries, rose 4.9 percent.
Construction remained weak in August, showing a 6.1 percent decline from the previous month.
